NH-0001.name: Deepwood Lodges
NH-0001.description: Seasonal Lake Winnipesaukee cottages with a shared sandy beach, guest boats and direct availability inquiries.

address.notes: Shared cottage-community contact/campus address; not an individual cottage entrance.

NH-0001.kidsDetails: Official amenities page describes beach fun for all ages and shallow swimming.
NH-0001.capacityDetails: 17 unique cottages on the current official site; unit sizes and capacities vary. Cottage 5/6 sleep 7, Cottage 7 sleeps 6, Cottage 8/14/16 sleep 8 and Cottage 12 sleeps 10; these are not an operator-wide capacity.
NH-0001.bookingMethod: Direct availability inquiry by telephone, email or contact form
NH-0001.notes: Official footer identifies Deepwood Lodges Home Owners Assoc.; seasonal guests Memorial Day to Columbus Day, with returning-guest priority and limited peak availability. Official site says 17 cottages, tourism profile says 12 units. The cottage-detail widget failed after opening Cottage 1, but the main website, public amenities and direct-contact method work. Photos show the shared campus, not one individual cottage.
gaps: Unit-specific capacity and bedrooms; operator record spans different cottages

NH-0003.name: Ames Farm Inn
NH-0003.description: Family-run Lake Winnipesaukee cottages, apartments and rooms on 135 acres, with a sandy beach, boat facilities and direct inquiries.

address.notes: Shared lakeside resort/cottage campus; unit entrances not separately established.

NH-0003.kidsDetails: Official website describes family vacations and policies refer to children on the shared grounds.
NH-0003.petsDetails: Published policy: no pets for overnight rentals, weekly rentals or restaurant customers.
NH-0003.capacityDetails: Operator offers 17 lakeside cottages, 14 apartments, 4 rooms and 2 additional cottages. Lakeside cottages include one- and two-bedroom types; another cottage is three bedrooms. Do not apply any one unit size to the operator.
NH-0003.priceDetails: Published approximate 2026 rates: rooms from $270/night spring/fall; lakeside cottages $2300-$2600/week spring/fall or $3400-$3800/week summer, varying by cottage. Selected spring/fall cottage nightly rates $479-$589. Subject to change; stated 8.5% NH tax additional.
NH-0003.bookingMethod: Book Now opens direct Contact Us page with form, telephone and email
NH-0003.notes: Official site describes fifth-generation operation, established in 1890 on Ames-family land held since 1777. Cottage/apartment vacation offerings qualify beyond the inn rooms. Photos show shared campus and shoreline, not a fabricated single rental. Generic Bosque escondido text appears in a secondary footer; primary contact and all accommodation content consistently identify Ames Farm Inn in Gilford.
gaps: Unit-specific numeric capacity and bedrooms; operator offers multiple accommodation types

NH-0004.name: The Patio Cabins
NH-0004.description: Locally owned year-round Twin Mountain cabins with kitchenettes, porches, a seasonal pool and direct Cloudbeds booking.

address.notes: Official website uses Twin Mountain; direct booking uses Carroll, the encompassing municipality, at 952 US-3 North. No separate Contact page is linked: contact footer on accommodation page and Address and Contact section of direct booking page both checked. Directory alias gives PO Box 147, not the rental entrance.

NH-0004.kidsDetails: Published playground policy permits children with supervision; family stays described.
NH-0004.petsDetails: Only cabins 4, 5 and 6, subject to direct approval, availability and breed restrictions; $30 flat pet fee. Pets cannot be left alone and must be leashed.
NH-0004.capacityDetails: 11 cabins and 1 suite. Two-room cabins 1, 6 and 11 sleep up to 5; two-bed cabins sleep 4; Suite 12 sleeps 4. Capacity and bedroom count vary by unit.
NH-0004.priceDetails: Published cabin starting rates: queen $99, two-bed $115, two-room $130, Suite $155. Midweek stays of at least two nights; NH tax, add-ons and promotions excluded. Actual dated price in booking engine.
NH-0004.bookingMethod: Operator-linked Cloudbeds direct booking; availability controls and property identity/contact inspected without selecting dates or submitting a reservation
NH-0004.notes: Official Meet the Hosts identifies local owners Chelsie and Nick, who bought the property in 2023. Direct booking identifies The Patio Cabins and matching address/phone/email. Patio Motor Court is the earlier name; same domain, place and Facebook identity. Preserve NH-0033 as duplicate audit row; do not publish twice. The four photos are all labeled Cabin 1 in the official accommodation gallery; unit facts are not assigned to this operator card.
gaps: Unit-specific capacity and bedrooms; operator record spans multiple cabins
